primary_estimand: Effect of 12-week high-phosphate diet (2% Pi, HP) vs normal-phosphate diet (0.6% Pi, NP) on gastrocnemius gene expression (S4.4.p1, FIG5). Exercise is a phenotypic outcome (treadmill capacity, S4.2.p2), not a factor of the RNA-seq design.
sample_inclusion: n = 3 per diet group, male C57BL/6, 20-24 weeks old (FIG5, S2.2.p1); no exercise state is stated for the sequenced animals; related mitochondria assays are explicitly from non-exercised mice (FIG4 legend)
planned_contrasts: HP vs NP diet (S4.4.p1, FIG5; paper: 'over 5,000' DEGs)
paper_results: over 5,000 DEGs HP vs NP (S4.4.p1); down: Fabp4, Fabp5, Lipe (Hsl), Fasn, Pparg, Adipoq, Pnpla3; up: Gck, Hk2, Pgk1, Irs2, Ldha, Slc2a4 (Glut4)
